name: Life To Unlife
body:
School necromancy [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a sharp edge)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level or until ended
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You inflict a bleeding wound upon yourself, causing 1 bleed damage per round. Each undead creature within 30 ft. of you heals 1 hit point of damage as negative energy up to their maximum hit points. When the spell ends, so does the bleed damage. If the bleed damage ends before the duration is up, the spell ends prematurely. You must be a living creature to cast this spell.
